versions.name: Camp Orr
versions.address: Camp Orr, near Jasper, AR (Buffalo National River)

features.note: Backpacking treks on the Buffalo River Trail from camp.
Canoe float trips on the Buffalo National River.
Climbing on the bluffs of the Buffalo National River wilderness area.
Buffalo Trail, an all-day track for Scouts who have just crossed over or have limited camping experience.
The council brands the property a high-adventure base, with named canoe-float and backpacking treks run from camp.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident summer camp in Jasper, Arkansas, offering merit-badge programs along with high-adventure treks.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
